title: Image toolchain step 2: Style profile in the backend
description:
Build step 2 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9). Revised 2026-11-07 for named image types.

`visual-style` doctrine kind, `metadata.visualStyle` schemaVersion 2 (identity, treatment and use bases, `imageTypes` with `extends`, `display`, `sources`, `typePreference`, `figureSystem`) and `metadata.imageReview`, `resolve_visual_style` with the type layer and `removeFromParent`, default-type choice per use and operation, constraints, `NewsroomSection.visualStyle` (may target a type), `image-service` Lambda with `imageRead`/`imageWrite` and the profile operations, `papyrus images profile ...`, editorial-context `visual-style` entry, context pack `visual_style` layer listing the types and `illustrator` profile, the prompt skeleton (5.9) with its `{image type}` slot and no-literals lint.

Specs: `image-profile.feature` and `image-types.feature`: two publications never leak; precedence previewable with sources, including the type and its parent; a child type's `removeFromParent` is recorded and cannot touch a constraint or `never` item; a Story override cannot remove a constraint; cycles and unknown parents refused at save; omitted type on a cover picks the default and says so; omitted type inline gives `image_type_required` with choices; generating a figure-system type gives `source_not_allowed`; agents cannot edit constraints; a profile edit makes a new version and old snapshots stay; no profile gives the warning and a skeleton-only plan.

What deploys: Backend: one optional field, one Lambda, two GraphQL fields. One site, then all.

Fulfils or changes: e4bdd096 (profile half).

Gherkin specs are required. Style guidance is data, never code. Spending is only approved for step 6.
